package: SOIC-14 (TI D, R-PDSO-G14), body 8.65 mm x 6.00 mm nom (incl. leads)
description: Hex Schmitt-trigger inverter, 1.65 V to 3.6 V VCC, 5.5 V tolerant inputs, 24 mA output drive at 3.3 V (TI SCAS285AA, Jun 2015).

pinout.name: 1A
pinout.notes: Inverter 1 data input (Pin Functions table sec 6, SOIC column, and the D-package Top View diagram).

decoupling.placement: as close to the VCC terminal as possible
decoupling.notes: Sec 11 Power Supply Recommendations: single-supply device -> 0.1 uF bypass; 0.1 uF + 1 uF in parallel commonly used to reject different noise frequencies.

land_pattern.notes: From the D (R-PDSO-G14) LAND PATTERN DATA sheet (drawing 4211283-3/E, 08/12), Example Board Layout: 12 x 1.27 mm pitch (7 pads per row), 5.40 mm between the centerlines of the two pad rows. Pad geometry 0.60 mm x 1.55 mm, non-soldermask-defined with solder mask opening 0.07 mm larger all around. Stencil openings 14 x 0.55 mm x 1.50 mm. Identical to the SN74LVC00AD land pattern (same TI drawing).

layout_notes: HYSTERESIS (Electrical Characteristics 7.7, SN74LVC14A) at VCC = 3 V, all temperature ranges: VT+ = 0.9 V min / 2 V max; VT- = 0.6 V min / 1.5 V max; hysteresis dVT = (VT+ - VT-) = 0.3 V min / 1.2 V max. At VCC = 2.7 V: VT+ 0.8-2 V, VT- 0.4-1.4 V, dVT 0.3-1.1 V. At VCC = 3.6 V: VT+ 1.1-2 V, VT- 0.8-1.7 V, dVT 0.3-1.2 V. These are the specified input thresholds - the datasheet gives NO VIH/VIL table for this Schmitt-trigger part.
Unused inputs must never float: all unused inputs must be held at VCC or GND (Recommended Operating Conditions note 1; sec 12.1 Layout Guidelines).
Bypass: 0.1 uF as close to the VCC terminal as possible; 0.1 uF + 1 uF in parallel commonly used (sec 11).
Output drive at 3.3 V (Recommended Operating Conditions 7.4, VCC = 3 V): IOH = -24 mA, IOL = 24 mA (all specified temperature ranges).

Output levels at VCC = 3 V (Electrical Characteristics 7.7): VOH >= 2.4 V at IOH = -12 mA and >= 2.2 V at IOH = -24 mA over -40 to 85 C (2.3 V typ at 25 C, 2.0 V over -40 to 125 C); VOL <= 0.55 V at IOL = 24 mA over -40 to 85 C (0.8 V over -40 to 125 C).

Propagation delay at VCC = 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V (Switching Characteristics 7.9, test load RL = 500 ohm, VLOAD = 6 V, CL = 50 pF, VM = 1.5 V, input tr/tf <= 2.5 ns, Figure 2): tpd A -> Y = 1 ns min, 3.2 ns typ at 25 C, 6.2 ns max at 25 C, 6.4 ns max over -40 to 85 C, 8 ns max over -40 to 125 C. Output-to-output skew tsk(o) = 1.5 ns max at 3.3 V. NOTE this is roughly 1.5x slower than the SN74LVC00A NAND (4.3 ns max at 3.3 V).
The datasheet does NOT specify an output rise/fall (transition) time or slew rate - only tpd and tsk(o) are characterized.

Supply range 1.65 V to 3.6 V (SN74LVC14A); 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V is a fully specified column in 7.9. VCC MAX IS 3.6 V - not rated for a 5 V rail (inputs/outputs tolerate 5.5 V per Recommended Operating Conditions VI = 0 to 5.5 V; sec 10.2.2 text conflicts and says 3.6 V, see OPEN).
Design limits (sec 10.2.2): load currents should not exceed +/-50 mA.
Cpd (power dissipation capacitance) = 15 pF typ at VCC = 3.3 V, f = 10 MHz, TA = 25 C (sec 7.10). Ci = 5 pF at 3.3 V.
Function table, each inverter (Table 1): A = H -> Y = L; A = L -> Y = H.
Thermal: RthJA = 86 C/W for the D (SOIC-14) package (sec 7.5).
Populate option (board-level, not from the datasheet): this part is a DNP alternative; the footprint must still be a correct SOIC-14 D land pattern.
